capabilities: Render flashcard code blocks as preview cards with front/back toggle
Sync flashcards to Anki with create and update per block
Define note types and templates in markdown files under an Anki folder
Read card field values from note frontmatter
Upload linked audio files to Anki media and play them in previews
extras: The README states this is an early version released to catch distribution issues, and it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; sync has a 100 MB limit per audio file and skips oversized fields.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to author flashcards in notes and sync them to Anki, including note types, decks, tags, and audio media.

relations.evidence: syncs them to Anki through AnkiConnect

summary: Flashcard sync plugin that renders flashcard code blocks as card previews and pushes them to Anki decks via AnkiConnect.
